tei:div.tei:p: skabs brgyad pa 'bras bu chos sku/

gsum pa 'bras bu chos sku bshad pa la gnyis te/ 'brel bkod pa/ dbye ba rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ lam sbyor bzhi'i rnal 'byor nyams su blangs pas rnam pa rnams je gsal du gyur te rang 'od kyis rang gi mun pa bsal ba ltar skye ba med pa gsum car mngon sum du rtogs pa'i chos sku thob par 'gyur te/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba bzhi pa'i mdo las 'phros nas gsungs pa'i don no// gnyis pa (dbye ba rgyas par bshad pa )la gnyis te/ spyi'i don dang*/ gzhung don no/ /dang po la gnyis te/ sku'am thugs kyi rnam gzhag /des shes bya mkhyen tshul lo// dang po ni/ kun gzhi'i ye shes yum chen mo bde gshegs snying po de la chos dbyings ye shes zhes kyang bya/ rten 'brel yang dag pa'i ye shes sna tshogs 'char bas/ sngags nas rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa'i ye shes kyi sku zhes kyang gsungs so/ /de ni chos sku'am ngo bo nyid sku ste dbye gzhi'o/ /de la gdod nas dri mas gos ma myong ba 'od gsal ba'i cha ni me long ye shes te longs sku'o/ /de'i dmigs pa med pa'i byams chen sems can thams cad la mnyam par khyab pa'i cha ni mnyam nyid ye shes so/ /de la rten 'brel sna tshogs 'char ba'i cha nas sor rtog ye shes/ des sems can thams cad kyi don sgrub pa'i phrin las kyi cha nas bya sgrub ye shes te sprul pa'i sku'o/ /des na kun gzhi'i rnam shes sogs kyi dri ma bral ba las ye shes de dang de snang ba yin gyi de de dag tu 'gyur ba ni min te/ dper na sprin bsal bas nyi 'od 'byung yang sprin nyi 'od du gyur pa ma yin pa bzhin no/ /de rnams ni sangs rgyas rang gi gnas tshul las phye ba yin la gdul bya la snang ba'i gzugs sku dang gsung dbyangs mdzad pa rnams ni bya ba yul la yod pa'i phrin las kyi cha gdul bya rang rgyud gnyis snang gi chas bsdus pa'o// gnyis pa (des shes bya mkhyen tshul )ni/

sangs rgyas kyi ye shes la mnyam rjes kyi rnam gzhag don la bzhag tu med kyang tha snyad kyi ngor mnyam gzhag kho nar bzhugs pa yin la/ de'i tshe gnyis snang sa bon dang bcas pa med pa'i phyir ye shes de la kun rdzob mi snang ngo*/ /dper na rab rib bral na skra shad mi snang ba bzhin no// 'o na thams cad mkhyen par mi 'gyur ro snyam na/ skyon med de/ chos rnams kyi gnas tshul yod nges thams cad mkhyen pa'i phyir/ bden bzhi'i gnas lugs shes pa bzhin no/ /de ltar klu sgrub kyis/ de bzhin kun rdzob shes pa dag /blo gros mig ni bye gyur cing*/ /mi shes gnyid dang bral gyur nas/ /sad pa'i tshe na mi gzigs so// snang tshul mkhyen pa ni/ snang tshul nyid de gdul bya'i rgyud kyi bsdus pa gzugs skur snang ba dang chos gsung bar snang ba lta bu'o// ngo bo nyid sku/ gnyis pa gzhung don la bzhi ste/ ngo bo nyid sku/ longs sku/ sprul sku/ phrin las bshad pa'o/ /dang po (ngo bo nyid skuu )la gnyis te/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ thub pa'i ngo bo nyid sku ni// zag pa med pa'i chos gang dag/ thob gyur rnam kun rnam dag pa// de dag rang bzhin mtshan nyid can// thub pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi chos sku ni/ de la zag pa med pa'i chos gang dag yod pa thams cad ngang gis thob par gyur pa'i cha dang*/ de sngar nas dri mas rnam pa kun tu rnam par dag pa de dag rang bzhin dbyer med gcig 'dres par gyur pa don la mtshan nyid med pa'i mtshan nyid can zhig go /mdo ni/ mtshan nyid med pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /zhes so// gnyis pa (rgyas par bshad pa )la gsum ste/ zag med kyi chos brgya bzhi bcu so sor bshad/ nyon mongs med pa dang smon gnas mkhyen pa dmigs kyis phye ba/ khyab pa dang rtag pa'i don bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ byang chub phyogs mthun tshad med dang*// rnam par thar dang mthar gyis ni// snyoms 'jug dgu yi bdag nyid dang*//

zad par bcu yi bdag nyid dang*// zag med kyi chos gang zhe na/ lam thams cad kyang 'di'i yul can gyi dri ma bral rim gyis thob pas cung zad cung zad bral ba dang thams cad bral ba'i dbye bas byang phyogs nas chos sku'i bar rnams bstan pa/ byang chub phyogs mthun tshad med dang*/ rnam par thar dang mthar gyi ni// snyoms 'jug dgu yi bdag nyid dang*/ /zhes pa rnams bstan zin la/ 'byung ba bzhi/ kha dog bzhi/ nam mkha'/ rnam shes rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin te/ zad par bcu yi bdag nyid la/ rten/ sgom tshul/ sgra don no/ /dang po ni/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi'o/ /gnyis pa (sgom tshul )ni/ dang por sgom tshul sa la dmigs rten ma gsungs la/ gzhan snod chus bkang ba me 'bar ba rlung lus la phog pa tshon sngo ser dmar dkar gyi dkyil 'khor mtho gang ngam sor bzhi pa'i bug pa mar me'i 'od rtsig ngos la phog pa rnams la dmigs nas de dag gi ming sa sogs yid la byas nas de dang des chos kun la khyab par bsgom zhing*/ de brtan pa'i mtshan mar nam mkhar gnas pa'i nor bu'i rlung g.yab dang zla ba dmar po lta bu dang 'dug pa ltar mi g.yo ba dang dmigs rten kha dog de rnams nam mkhar 'phags nas nor bu'i rlung g.yab ltar mkhar snang ba dang bu ga bskyed nas nam mkha' ltar 'phel ba dang rab tu dang bas phyogs kun snang ba 'dra ba rnams 'grub pa'i rtags so/ /chu lbu ba can me du ba can rlung rlangs pa can sngo sogs bzhi la me tog ge sar dang sdong bu med pa lta bu/ bu ga bskyed mi nus pa thogs bcas su snang ba ni mi 'grub pa'i rtags so/ /phyis goms nas so sor dmigs pa mthong ba'i mod la ting nge 'dzin gsal bar 'gyur zhing*/ gcig nas mang po sogs dang chu dang nam mkhar gom pa 'dor ba dang sar 'dzul ba dang me sbar ba dang rlung ltar mgyogs pa dang bai ḍūrya sogs kyi sa gzhir bsgyur ba dang rtsig pa la thogs med 'gro ba dang gnyid rmugs rgyang ring du byed do/

/gsum pa (sgra don )ni/ rgyun mi 'chad du mtha' yas par spro ba'o// zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched ni// rab tu dbye bas rnam brgyad dang*// nyon mongs med dang smon mkhyen dang*// mngon shes so so yang dag rig/ rnam pa thams cad dag bzhi dang*// dbang bcu dang ni stobs bcu dang*// mi 'jigs pa ni bzhi dag dang*// bsrung ba med pa rnam gsum dang*// dran pa nyer gzhag rnam gsum dang*// bsnyel ba mi mnga'i chos nyid dang*// bag chags yang dag bcom pa dang*// skye la thugs rje chen po dang*// thub pa kho na'i ma 'dres chos// bco brgyad bshad pa gang yin dang*// rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid dang*// chos kyi sku zhes brjod pa yin// zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched ni/ rang la gzugs la 'du shes pas phyi rol gyi gzugs chung ngu bcud kyi sems can dang chen po snod kyi 'jig rten/ bzang po lha dang ngan pa mi la blta zhing gzugs de dag zil gyis gnan nas zhi gnas kyis shes lhag mthong gis mthong ba ni zil gnon gnyis/ rang la gzugs med par 'du shes pas de ltar blta ba zil gnon gnyis bzhi po 'di ni rnam thar dang po gnyis las 'byung ba'o/ rang la gzugs med par 'du shes pa kho nas phyi'i gzugs kha dog lhan skyes sngon po dang sbyar ba'i sngon po lta bur ston pa gnyis kar 'od sngon po 'byung ba rnams blta zhing zil gyis mnan nas shes mthong ngo*/ /de bzhin ser dkar dmar por blta ba ni zil gnon bzhi ste/ dbyibs kyi bzhi/ kha dog gi bzhir rab tu dbye bas rnam brgyad dang*/ mdor/ kha dog la lhan skyes dang sbyar byung gi dpe gnyis gnyis kyang gsungs so/ /sgra don ni/ dbang 'byor ba'i phyir dmigs pa zil gyis gnon pa'o// de nas/ nyon mongs med dang smon mkhyen dang*/ /mngon shes so so yang dag rig /len pa gnas pa gtong ba la mnga' brnyes pas lus yongs dag dang*/ sprul bsgyur la mnga' brnyes pas dmigs pa yongs dag dang*/

ting nge 'dzin la mnga' brnyes pas thugs yongs dag dang*/ ye shes la mnga' brnyes pas mkhyen pa yongs dag ste/ rnam pa thams cad dag bzhi dang*/ tshe byin gyis brlabs nas bskal pa'i bar du gnas nus pa dang*/ sems kyis ji ltar 'dod pa'i ting nge 'dzin la 'jug nus pa dang*/ yo byad nor gyi char 'bebs nus pa dang*/ khams gong na myong 'gyur las 'dod par myong bar byed pa lta bu dang*/ bsam gtan las ma nyams par 'dod par skye nus pa lta bu dang*/ sa chur chu sar sogs mos pa tsam gyis bsgyur nus pa dang*/ gzhan don zad pa med pa'i smon lam 'grub pa dang*/ rdzu 'phrul dpag med gdul bya 'dul phyir ston pa dang*/ so so yang dag par rig pa'i ye shes dang*/ bsam pa dang 'tsham par chos ston pa ste/ dbang bcu dang ni stobs bcu dang*/ /mi 'jigs pa ni bzhi dag dang*/ /sgo gsum gyi spyod pa shin tu dag pas gzhan la bcab dgos mi 'byung bas 'khor gyi nang duu bag brkyang nas gsung pa ni bsrung ba med pa rnam gsum dang*/ chos nyan pa gus ma gus cha mnyam can gsum la chags sdang cha mnyam gyi g.yeng ba gsum mi mnga' ba btang snyoms kyi dran pa nyer gzhag rnam gsum dang*/ sems can gyi don dus yol gyi bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba'i mdzad pa 'bras bu can gyi chos nyid dang*/ sgrib gnyis kyi bag chags yang dag par bcom pas rgyu ba dang gnas pa nam du yang kun mkhyen min pa'i spyod pa lus ngag 'gyur ba med pa dang*/ su dar su rgud ces nyin mtshan lan drug tu skye ba thams cad la thugs rje chen pos gzigs pa dang*/ thub pa kho na'i ma 'dres chos/ /bco brgyad bshad pa gang yin dang*/ /sku gsum gyi byang chub brnyes nas sems can kun gyi the tshom gcod pa'i rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid dang*/ de dag thams cad yongs su rdzogs pas chos kyi sku zhes brjod pa yin no/ /mdo ni/ zag pa med pa'i chos de dag kyang gang lags/ bka' stsal pa/

byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos so bdun dang*/ zhes sogs so// gnyis pa (nyon mongs med pa dang smon gnas mkhyen pa dmigs kyis phye ba) ni/ nyan thos nyon mongs med pa'i lta// mi yi nyon mongs yongs spong nyid// grong sogs su de'i nyon mongs rnams// rgyun gcod rgyal ba'i nyon mongs med// nyan thos dang rang rgyal gyi nyon mongs pa med pa'i lta ba ni gzhan gyi nyon mongs pa skye ba'i rkyen spong ba tsam dang rang rgyud la med pa tsam yin la/ mi la sogs pa'i gdul bya mang po'i rgyud kyi nyon mongs yongs su spong ba nyid dang grong la sogs pa rnams su phebs pa tsam gyis der gnas pa'i skye bo rnams kyi nyon mongs rnams rgyun gcod pa'i mthu yod pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni rgyal ba sangs rgyas kyi nyon mongs med pa'o// sangs rgyas smon gnas mkhyen pa ni// lhun gyis grub dang chags spangs dang*// thogs pa med dang rtag gnas dang*// 'dri ba kun lan 'debs par bzhed// yang nyan rang gi smon gnas shes pa ni shes bya gang rung zhig shes par smon nas smon lam sngon du song ba las smon pa'i gnas de shes pa yin la/ sangs rgyas kyi smon gnas mkhyen pa ni/ gzod nas lhun gyis grub pa dang chags pa spangs pa dang thogs pa med par 'jug pa dang rtag tu mnyam bzhag la gnas pa dang*/ de'i ngang las the tshom can gyi dri ba kun gyi lan 'debs nus par bzhed do// gsum pa (khyab pa dang rtag pa'i don bstan pa) ni/ rgyu ni yongs su smin gyur nas// gang dang gang la gang dang ni// gang tshe bya ba phan gyur pa// de dang de la de snang ngo*// chos sku ye gdod nas lhun grub tu bzhugs na sems can thams cad la mi snang ba ci/ gzhan don mi 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas kyang yod pa yin nam snyam na/ dri ma glo bur bar shes nas mnyam nyid kyi rnal 'byor sgom pa'i rgyu ni/ yongs su smin par gyur pa nas dad pa la sogs pa'i rkyen gyis gsos btab pa na gdul bya gang dang gang la 'dul byed gang dang ni gang gi tshe phrin las kyi bya bas dri ma bsal zhing rtogs pa 'phel ba'i sgo nas phan par gyur pa na gdul bya de'i dag snang dang 'tsham par de la de snang ngo*/

/de lta min par sems can thams cad kyis mi mthong ba'i tshul ni/ lha yi rgyal pos char phab kyang*// sa bon mi rung mi 'khrungs ltar// sangs rgyas rnams ni byung gyur kyang*// skal ba med pas bzang mi myong*// dper na lha'i rgyal pos char phyogs ris med par phab pas/ sa bon nus ldan las 'bras bu bskyed kyang sa bon rul ba lta bu'i mi rung ba las 'bras bu mi 'khrungs pa ltar/ sangs rgyas rnams ni dus gsum rgyun chad med par byung bar gyur kyang ma rig pas bsgribs pa'i skal ba med pa rnams kyi 'bras bu bzang po mi myong zhing mi 'thob bo// de ltar mdzad pa rgya che'i phyir// sangs rgyas khyab par nges par brjod// de nyid zad pa med pa'i phyir// rtag pa zhes kyang brjod pa yin// des na rnam shes la mi snang bas chos sku khyab rtag min par mi 'gyur te/ lha'i char de ltar mdzad pa rgya che ba'i phyir sangs rgyas khyab par nges par brjod/ 'dus ma byas shing lhun gyis grub/ /ces rgyud blar gsungs pa ltar/ de nyid zad pa med pa'i phyir/ /rtag pa zhes kyang brjod pa yin// longs sku/ gnyis pa longs sku la gnyis te/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ mtshan ni sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*// dpe byad brgyad cu'i bdag nyid 'di// theg chen nye bar longs spyod phyir// thub pa'i longs spyod rdzogs skur bzhed// sangs rgyas rang gi gnas tshul la ye shes kyi mtshan dpe 'bar la/ theg chen 'phags pa la de las dman pa dang*/ nyan thos sogs la de las kyang rags pa'i mtshan dpe snang ba'o/ /des na gzhan snang gi longs sku'i dbang du byas nas/ mtshan ni sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ /dpe byad brgyad cu'i bdag nyid 'di/ /theg chen kho na'i chos la nye bar longs spyod pa'i phyir/ thub pa'i longs spyod rdzogs skur bzhed do/ /mdo ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/

zhes sogs so// gnyis pa (rgyas par bshad pa )la gnyis te/ mtshan/ dpe byad bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ phyag zhabs 'khor lo mtshan dang rus sbal zhabs// phyag dang zhabs sor dra bas 'brel ba dang*// phyag ni zhabs bcas 'jam zhing gzhon sha chags// 'di yi sku ni bdun dag mtho ba dang*// sor mo ring dang rting yangs sku che drang*// zhabs 'bur mi mngon spu ni gyen du phyogs// byin pa e na ya'i 'dra phyag ring mdzes// 'doms kyi sba ba sbubs su nub pa'i mchog/ lpags pa gser mdog lpags pa srab pa dang*// spu ni re re nas g.yas legs 'khrungs dang*// zhal mdzod spus brgyan ro stod seng ge'i 'dra// 'di yi dpung pa'i mgo zlum thal gong rgyas// 'di la ro mi zhim pa'ang ro mchog snang*// sku ni n+ya gro dha ltar mchu zheng gab// gtsug gtor dbur ldan ljags ring mdzes pa dang*// tshangs dbyangs 'gram pa seng ge'i 'dra dang tshems// shin tu dkar dang tshad mnyam thags bzang dang*// grangs ni bzhi bcu tham pa tshang ba dang*// spyan ni mthon 'thing spyan rdzi ba mchog gi/ 'dra ba 'di dag sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan//

sngon las kyi rgyu dang mtshan rang gi gnas tshul dang snga ltas kyi 'bras bu gsum gsum gyis ston te/ sngon bla ma bsu skyel dang chos nyan la bstod pa dang mchod rten la bsti stang byas pa'i rgyus phyag zhabs la rtsibs stong ldan pa'i 'khor lo ba so la brkos pa 'dra bas mtshan pa dang de ni 'khor shin tu mnga' ba'i snga ltas so/ /de bzhin sbyar nas/ dam bca' brtan pas rus sbal gyi lto ba ltar zhabs mthil mnyam pa ni mi g.yo ba'i dang*/ bsdu ba bzhir goms pas phyag dang zhabs kyi sor mo'i bar sor gdub bzhes pa la mi gnod pa'i dra bas 'brel ba bya ngang pa'i lta bu ni 'khor myur du 'du ba'i dang*/ bza' btung zhim la mang ba gzhan la sbyin pas phyag ni zhabs bcas 'jam zhing gzhon sha chags pa dang*/ 'di'i sku ni zhabs mthil gnyis phyag mthil gnyis phrag pa gnyis ltag pa ste bdun po dag tu kyong med par gzhan dang mnyam pas mtho ba de gnyis ni bza' bca' dang btung ba nyams su bde ba thob pa'i ltas dang*/ bcings pa bkrol bas sor mo ring ba zhabs mthil gyi dkyus dang mtho mnyam pa dang*/ srog bskyabs pas rting pa yangs pa zhabs bzhi cha phyir 'phags pa dang*/ srog gcod spangs pas sku'i ring thung la mi phal pa'i khru phyed dang bcu gcig yod pas byin las khru bdun gyi che zhing dgye sgur ma song bas drang ba dang gsum ni sku tshe ring ba'i dang*/ dge ba'i chos blangs pas zhabs pus mo'i lha nga dang long bu phyir 'bur ba mi mngon pa dang*/ dge ba blangs pa cher spel bas sku'i spu ni gyen du rtse mo phyogs pa dang gnyis ni mi mnyam pa'i chos dang ldan pa'i dang*/ rig pa dang bzo'i las rang gis blangs shing gzhan la sbyin pas byin pa 'tsham la zlum pa ri dwags e ṇa ya ste sha ba'i byin pa 'dra ba ni myur du 'dzin pa'i dang*/ ser sna ma byas pas ma btud par phyag mthil pus mo'i lha ngar sleb pas ring zhing mdzes pa ni yo byad mang ba dang dul ba'i dang*/

mdza' ba ma phye ba dang gzhan tshangs spyod la bskul zhing gsang tshig bsrungs pas rta cang shes ltar 'doms kyi sba ba sbubs su nub pa mchog ni bu mang ba'i dang*/ gzhan la gos stan byin pas lpags pa gser gyi mdog ltar snum pa dang*/ khang pa dang yul gnas sbyin pas lpags pa skyi srab la 'jam pa dang gnyis ni gos stan khang bzang gnas bzang thob pa'i dang*/ 'du 'dzi spangs pas ba spu ni bu ga gcig na gnyis med par re re nas g.yas 'khyil legs 'khrungs dang*/ mkhan slob pha ma sogs tshul bzhin bkur bas zhal gyi smin mtshams su spu dkar 'jam 'od dang ldan pa shin tu phra ba sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi mdzod spu g.yas 'khyil gyis brgyan pa dang gnyis ni mnyam pa med pa'i dang*/ smod lan du snyan par smras pas ro stod phel ka che ba seṅge'i 'dra ba dang*/ legs bshad mthun par 'dzin pas 'di'i dpung pa'i mgo rgyas shing zlum pa dang gnyis ni thub pa med pa'i dang*/ nad pa la sman dpyad rim gro byin pas thal gong mgrin pa zlum zhing mthong ga rgyas pa dang*/ 'di la rtsi dang phan pa'i zas sbyin pas phal la ro mi zhim pa yang ro mchog tu snang ba dang gnyis ni nad nyung ba'i dang*/ gzhan la skyed mos tshal byin pas sku ni ring thung dang 'dom tshad snyoms pas shing n+ya gro dha ltar mchu zheng gab pa dang*/ gtsug lag khang byin pas gtsug tor g.yas 'khyil zlum po dbu'i steng du sor bzhi tsam 'phags pa ldan pa dang gnyis ni mnga' thang che ba'i dang*/ tshig snyan cing 'jam pa kho na smras pas ljags kyis skra mtshams dang snyan gyi bar du khebs pas ring zhing mdzes pa dang*/ thams cad la dam pa'i chos go bar byas pas gsung tshangs pa'i dbyangs ltar nang du ji lta bar phyir thag ring du'ang thos pa dang gnyis ni yan lag lnga ldan gyi gsung mnga' ba'i dang*/ yan lag lnga ni/ yongs su shes shing shes par 'gyur ba dang*/ mnyan na dga' ba dang zab cing dbyangs rjes su 'byung ba dang btang mi bra ba dang ma 'khrugs shing gsal ba'o/

/tshig 'khyal spangs pas 'gram pa zlum rgyas seṅge'i 'dra ba ni tshig la kun gyis nyan pa'i dang*/ skye bo thams cad bkur bas tshems shin tu dkar ba dang*/ 'tsho ba rnam par dag pas tshems ring thung med par tshad mnyam pa gnyis ni 'khor snga nas sogs pa'i dang*/ bden pa'i tshig 'ba' zhig smras pas tshems thags bzang ba dang*/ phra ma spangs pas tshems grangs ni bzhi bcu tham pa tshang ba dang gnyis ni 'khor dbyer mi phyed pa'i dang*/ byams pa'i mig gis bltas pas spyan dkar nag ma 'dres pa nag po'i sa ni mthon mthing 'dra ba dang*/ chags sdang rmongs pa med par bltas pas spyan gyi rdzi ma ma 'dres pa ba khyu mchog gi dang 'dra ba gnyis ni kun nas mdzes pa'i snga ltas so// de ltar na/ 'di dag sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan/ /de dag gi rgyu bstan pa/ 'di la mtshan ni gang gang gi/ sgrub par byed pa'i rgyu gang yin// de dang de ni rab rdzogs pas// mtshan ni 'di dag yang dag 'grub// de gang zhe na/ bla ma skyel la sogs pa dang*// yang dag blangs pa brtan pa dang*// bsdu ba brten dang gya nom pa'i*// dngos po sbyin dang bsad bya ba// thar par byed dang dge ba ni// yang dag blangs pa spel la sogs// sgrub byed rgyu yi mtshan nyid de// mdo las ji skad 'byung ba bzhin// zhes gsungs pa rnams bkrol zin to// gnyis pa (dpe byad bshad pa )ni/ bcu tshan dang po ni/ thub pa'i sen mo zangs mdog dang*// mdog snum mtho dang sor mo rnams// zlum rgyas byin gyis phra ba dang*// rtsa mi mngon dang mdud pa med// long bu mi mngon zhabs mnyam dang*// 'du byed las dben pas thub pa'i sen mo zangs mdog dang*/ phan bde'i thugs mnga' bas sen mo mdog snum pa dang*/ rigs mtho bas sen mo mtho ba dang*/ kha na ma tho med pas sor mo rnams zlum pa dang*/ dge ba tshogs pas sor mo rgyas pa dang*/ dge ba grub pas sor mo'i rtse mo byin gyis phra ba dang*/ 'tsho ba rab tu bsrungs pas rtsa lpags pa'i phyir mi mngon pa dang*/

nyon mongs med pas rtsa mdud pa med pa dang*/ dben pa'i chos mnga' bas long bu nang du 'bur ba mi mngon pa dang*/ 'gran zla med pas zhabs gnyis ring thung che chung med par mnyam pa dang*/ bcu tshan gnyis pa ni/ seng ge glang chen bya dang ni// khyu mchog stabs gshegs g.yas phyogs dang*// mdzes gshegs drang dang 'khril bag chags// byi dor byas 'dra rim par 'tsham// mi'i seṅge yin pas brjid par seṅge dang*/ mi'i glang chen yin pas thad kar glang chen dang*/ nam mkhar gshegs pas bya ngang pa'i dang ni/ mi'i khyu mchog yin pas 'khor gyi sna 'dren pa khyu mchog gi stabs kyis gshegs pa dang*/ mthun pa'i lam mnga' bas g.yas phyogs nas 'byon zhing g.yas nas ldog pa dang*/ bltas na mdzes par gshegs pa dang*/ thugs ma g.yo bas sku drang por gshegs pa dang*/ dag pa'i yon tan ston pas sku 'gying legs pa 'khril bag chags pa dang*/ sdig pa med pas sku dri med byi dor byas 'dra dang*/ gdul byar 'tsham pa'i chos ston pas sbom phra dang skabs phyed pa'i rim par 'tsham pa dang*/ bcu tshan gsum pa ni/ gtsang dang 'jam dang dag pa'i sku// mtshan ni yongs su rdzogs pa dang*// sku yi kho lag yangs shing bzang*// gom snyoms pa dang spyan gnyis ni// dag dang gzhon sha can nyid dang*// sku zhum med dang rgyas pa dang*// kun spyod dag pas sku gtsang ba dang*/ thugs 'jam pas sku 'jam pa reg na bde ba dang*/ thugs dag pas sku dag pa dang*/ chos 'dul ba rdzogs pas mtshan so gnyis ni yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ yon tan yangs shing bzang bas sku'i kho lag khyon che ba yangs shing bzang ba dang*/ thugs thams cad la snyoms pas gom pa che chung snyoms pa dang*/ spyan gnyis ni gzigs pa dag pa dang*/ 'jam pa'i chos ston pas sku gzhon sha can nyid dang*/ thugs mi zhum pas sku sha zhum pa med pa dang*/ mi dge ba thams cad byang bas sku sha khengs te rgyas pa dang*/ bcu tshan bzhi pa ni/ shin tu grims pa'i sku nyid dang*//

yan lag shin tu rnam 'byes dang*// gzigs pa sgrib med dag pa dang*// sku zlum skabs phyin ma rnyongs dang*// phyang nge ba dang lte ba ni// zab dang g.yas phyogs 'khyil ba dang*// kun nas lta na sdug pa dang*// yang srid bcom pas sku mi lhod par shin tu grims pa'i sku nyid dang*/ rten 'brel ston pas yan lag rnams kyi ring 'os ring thung 'os thung ba shin tu rnam par 'byes pa dang*/ spyan la rab rib sogs gzigs par sgrib pa med cing mig rnag sogs mi 'byung bas dag pa dang*/ slob ma khrims ldan 'khor bas sku'i phyal zlum pa dang*/ 'khor ba'i skyon med pas rked skabs phyin pa dang*/ nga rgyal med pas phyal ma rnyongs pa rgyu ltongs min pa dang*/ chos ston pa zad pa med pas phyal la mtho kyong med pa phyang nge ba dang*/ chos zab mo rtogs pas lte ba'i khung bu ni gting zab pa dang*/ gdams ngag 'dzin pa'i slob ma 'du bas lte ba'i ri mo g.yas phyogs 'khyil ba dang*/ spyod lam mdzes pa'i dge 'dun 'du bas sku'i spyod pa kun nas lta na sdug pa dang*/ bcu tshan lnga pa ni/ kun spyod gtsang dang sku la ni// rme ba gnag bag med pa dang*// phyag ni shing bal ltar 'jam dang*// phyag ris mdangs yod zab ring dang*// zhal ni ha cang mi ring dang*// chu ni bim pa ltar dmar dang*// ljags mnyen pa dang srab pa dang*// sgo gsum gyi kun spyod gtsang ba dang*/ chos nag po bral bas sku la ni rme ba dang sha mtshan gnag bag med pa dang*/ nyams su len bde ba'i chos ston pas phyag ni shing bal ltar 'jam pa dang*/ dge sbyong chen po brnyes pas phyag gi ri mo la snum pa'i mdangs yod pa dang*/ brtan par bzhugs pas phyag gi ri mo zab pa dang*/ bzod pa'i chos ston pas phyag gi ri mo ring ba dang*/ bslab pa phra mo nas 'cha' bas zhal sgros ni ha cang mi ring ba dang*/ gzugs brnyan 'jig rten du bkye bas mchu ni me tog bim pa ltar dmar zhing gzugs brnyan snang ba dang*/

tshig 'jam pos 'dul bas ljags bde zhing mnyen pa dang*/ yon tan phra ba'i tshogs dang ldan pas ljags srab pa dang*/ bcu tshan drug pa ni/ dmar dang 'brug gi sgra nyid dang*// gsung mnyen 'jam dang mche ba zlum// rno dang dkar dang mnyam pa dang*// byin gyis phra dang shangs mtho dang*// mchog tu dag pa dag dang ni// chos 'dul ba gting dpag dka' bas ljags dmar ba dang*/ bsnyengs pa mi mnga' bas 'brug gi sgra ltar brjid pa nyid ldan pa dang*/ 'jam par smra ba'i slob ma mnga' bas gsung mnyen cing 'jam pa dang*/ srid par kun tu sbyor ba las 'das pas mche ba zlum pa dang*/ gdul dka' 'dul bas mche ba rno ba dang*/ chos 'dul ba dkar bas mche ba dkar ba dang*/ mnyam pa nyid la gnas pas mche ba ring thung sogs mnyam pa dang*/ mngon rtogs rim gyis ston pas mche ba'i rtse mo byin gyis phra ba dang*/ shes rab kyi ri bo la gnas pas shangs mtho ba dang*/ 'dul ba'i skye bo gtsang ma mnga' bas shangs la dri ma med pas mchog tu dag pa dag dang ni/ bcu tshan bdun pa ni/ spyan yangs pa dang rdzi ma stug/ padma'i 'dab ma 'dra ba dang*// smin tshugs ring dang 'jam pa dang*// snum dang spu ni mnyam pa dang*// phyag ring rgyas dang snyan mnyam dang*// nyams pa rnam par spangs pa dang*// sangs rgyas kyi chos yangs pa mnga' bas spyan dkyus ring zhing yangs pa dang*/ sems can gyi tshogs 'dren pas spyan gyi rdzi ma stug pa dang*/ lha dang lha min na chung sogs dga' bar byed pas spyan dkar nag phyed pa padma'i 'dab ma 'dra ba dang*/ phyi rjes su gzigs pas smin ma g.yas g.yon 'brel bas tshugs ring ba dang*/ 'jam por 'dul bas smin ma 'jam pa dang*/ dge ba'i snum dang ldan pas smin ma snum pa dang*/ skyon thams cad mkhyen pas smin ma'i spu ni ring thung sogs mnyam pa dang*/ gnod pa bzlog pas phyag ring zhing rgyas pa dang*/ nyon mongs las rgyal bas snyan mtho dman che chung mnyam pa dang*/ bsam pa ma nyams pas 'dul bas snyan 'on pa sogs nyams pa rnam par spangs pa dang*/

bcu tshan brgyad pa ni/ dpral ba legs par 'byes pa dang*// dbyes che ba dang dbu rgyas dang*// dbu skra bung ba ltar gnag dang*// stug dang 'jam dang ma 'dzings dang*// mi bshor dri zhim skyes bu yi// yid ni 'phrog par byed pa dang*// dpal gyi be'u dang bkra shis ni// sangs rgyas dpe byad bzang por bzhed// lta ba thams cad byang bas skra mtshams dod pa ni dpral ba legs par 'byes pa dang*/ phas rgol 'dul bas dpral ba'i dbyes che ba dang*/ smon lam dam pa rdzogs pas dbu gdugs ltar rgyas pa dang*/ yul gyi dga' ba ldog pas dbu la skra dkar mi 'byung zhing bung ba ltar kha dog gnag pa dang*/ spang bya'i bag nyal zad pas dbu skra stug pa dang*/ thugs 'jam pos bstan pa'i snying po thugs su chud pas skra 'jam pa dang*/ thugs ma 'khrugs pas skra ma 'dzings pa dang*/ brlang ba'i gsung dang bral bas skra gyen la ma brdzes pa mi bshor ba dang*/ byang chub yan lag gi spos bsgrubs pas skra'i dri zhim pas skyes bu'i yid ni 'phrog par byed pa dang*/ phyag zhabs la dpal gyi be'u dang bkra shis ni rdzas brgyad dang ri mo gru bzhi sogs yod pa ni sangs rgyas dpe byad bzang por bzhed do// sprul sku/ gsum pa sprul sku ni/ gang gis srid pa ji srid par// 'gro la phan pa sna tshogs dag/ mnyam du mdzad pa'i sku de ni// thub pa'i sprul sku rgyun mi 'chad// bzo sprul sku dri za'i rgyal po rab dga' 'dul ba'i phyir pi wang mkhan du sprul ba lta bu dang*/ skye ba sprul pa ni gzings zam pa sman 'bras bu 'bab chu sogs ji ltar 'dod pa'i sprul pa 'byung ba dang*/ byang chub chen po'i sprul sku ni mdzad pa bcu gnyis sogs ston pa'o/ /de ltar gdul bya gang la gang gis 'dul ba'i sku sna tshogs pas srid pa ji srid par 'gro la phan pa sna tshogs dag cig car mnyam du mdzad pa'i sku de ni thub pa'i sprul sku yin pas rgyun mi 'chad 'byung ngo*//

mdo ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa sna tshogs pa'i phrin las kyis sems can gyi don mdzad pa/ zhes so// phrin las bshad pa/ bzhi pa phrin las la gnyis te/ gnas tshul gyi phrin las mdor bstan/ snang tshul so sor bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de bzhin 'khor ba ji srid 'di'i// las ni rgyun mi 'chad par 'dod// sprul sku rgyun mi 'chad pa de bzhin du 'khor ba ji srid par chos dbyings ye shes 'di'i las rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba ni rgyun mi 'chad par 'dod de rtag pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa (snang tshul so sor bshad pa) ni/ 'gro rnams zhi ba'i lam dang ni// bsdu rnam bzhi la dgod pa dang*// kun nas nyon mongs bcas pa yi// rnam par byang ba rtogs pa dang*// sems can rnams don ji bzhin gyi// don dang pha rol phyin drug dang*// sangs rgyas lam dang rang bzhin gyis// stong pa nyid dang gnyis zad dang*// brda dang dmigs pa med pa dang*// lus can rnams ni yongs smin dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i lam dang ni// mngon par zhen pa bzlog pa dang*// byang chub thob dang sangs rgyas zhing*// rnam par dag dang nges pa dang*// sems can don ni tshad med dang*// sangs rgyas bsten sogs yon tan dang*//

byang chub yan lag las rnams ni// chud mi za dang bden mthong dang*// phyin ci log ni spangs pa dang*// de gzhi med pa'i tshul dang ni// rnam par byang dang tshogs dang ni// 'dus byas 'dus ma byas pa la// tha dad yongs su mi shes dang*// mya ngan 'das la dgod pa ste// chos kyi sku yi 'phrin las ni// rnam pa nyi shu bdun du bzhed// 'bad med du 'byung ba'i mdzad pa nyer bdun te/ ngan song gi 'gro ba rnams sdug bsngal dang 'dod lha rnams 'dod par zhen pa dang tshangs pa rnams lta ba zhi ba ste gcig ni lam gyi rten la 'god pa dang ni/ mi'i 'gro ba rnams bsdu ba rnam pa bzhi la 'god pa dang*/ thos bsam gyi dor bya kun nas nyon mongs dang bcas pa dang*/ blang bya rnam par byang ba rtogs pa gnyis ni tshogs lam la 'god pa dang*/ sems can rnams kyi don ji lta ba bzhin gyi lam tshad med bzhi'i don dang*/ pha rol phyin drug dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi lam dge bcu dang*/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong pa nyid du shes pa bzhi ni sbyor lam la 'god pa dang*/ gnyis chos thams cad gdod nas zad pa gcig ni mthong lam la 'god pa dang*/ tha snyad kyi chos rnams brdar btags pa tsam dang*/ 'khor gsum dmigs pa med pa dang*/ lus can gzhan rnams ni yongs su smin nus pa dang*/ nyan rang dang thun mong min pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i lam dang ni/ mngon par zhen pa'i 'dzin pa bzlog pa dang*/ byang chub thob pa ltar mdzad pa bcu ston nus pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi snod bcud kyi zhing rnam par dag par sbyong nus pa dang*/ skye ba phyi ma zhing 'dir sangs rgyas 'di zhes nges par 'gyur ba dang*/ sems can don ni tshad med sgrub nus pa dang*/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bsten pa dang sogs pas bsnyen bkur bgyid pa dang yon tan shes par nus pa dang*/ tshe 'di la byang chub chen po thob nus pa'i yan lag rdzogs pa dang*/ sangs rgyas thob nges pas dge ba'i las rnams ni chud mi za ba dang*/

bden pa'i de kho na nyid skad cig la mthong nus pa dang*/ rtag 'dzin sogs phyin ci log bzhi ni spangs pa dang*/ de'i gzhi yang dag min rtog gi sa bon med par byed pa'i tshul dang ni/ zag med rnam par byang ba'i chos rdzogs par byed pa dang*/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang ni/ 'dus byas 'khor ba 'dus ma byas pa myang 'das la tha dad yongs su mi shes pas mnyam pa nyid dang bco brgyad ni sgom lam la 'god pa dang*/ mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa la 'god pa ste gcig ni 'bras bu la 'god pa'o/ /mdo ni/ sems can dmyal ba rnams kyi sdug bsngal zhi bar byas nas/ zhes so// shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi tshig le'ur byas pa las skabs brgyad pa'o// // shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi tshig le'ur byas pa las skabs brgyad pa'i 'grel pa'o// // gnyis pa 'bring la mos pa'i gang zag la drug tu bstan pa ni/ mtshan nyid de yi sbyor ba dang*// de rab de yi go rim dang*// de mtha' de yi rnam smin ni// don bsdus gzhan de rnam pa drug/ gzhi lam 'bras bu dbyer mi phyed pa sher phyin gyi mtshan nyid mkhyen gsum gcig tu byas/ de rtogs byed kyi sbyor ba dang de rab dang de'i go rim dang de'i mtha' ste sbyor ba bzhi/ sbyor ba de'i rnam smin chos sku'i rang zhal mthong ba 'bras bu chos sku gcig dang bcas pa ni don bsdus gzhan te rnam pa drug go/ gsum pa bsdus pa la mos pa'i gang zag la gsum du bstan pa ni/ yul ni rnam pa gsum po rgyu// sbyor ba bzhi yi bdag nyid dang*// chos sku 'phrin las 'bras bu ni// don bsdus gzhan te rnam pa gsum// glo bur gyi dri ma rab rib lta bu sel ba'i yul kun gzhi'i ye shes yum sher phyin ldog cha nas ni mkhyen pa rnam pa gsum po ru phye ba gcig tu byas/

de la sgrib pa'i dri ma kun rdzob pa ri bong gi rwa lta bu de ltar yin par rtogs byed kyi rgyu skye med du sgom pa'i rnal 'byor gong 'phel gyi sgo nas phye ba sbyor ba bzhi'i bdag nyid gcig tu byas/ des 'khrul snang yul dang bcas pa dag nas rang ngo rang gis rig par gyur pa chos sku phrin las 'bras bu dang bcas pa gcig rnams ni don bsdus gzhan te rnam pa gsum mo// gsum pa mjug yongs su rdzogs pa'i bya ba ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi tshig le'ur byas pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po bidyā kā ra pra dzñā dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban de dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o//slad kyi paṇḍi ta dpal go mi 'chi med la sogs pa dang lo tsā ba dge slong blo ldan shes rab kyis legs par gtan la phab pa'o// // gang tshe skom pas nyen pa'i sems can phra mo'i mdun du glo bur rgya mtsho lud gyur na/ /de tshe rab tu skrag cing 'thung ba'i spros pa nye bar zhi bar 'gyur gyi gzhan du ci/ /de bzhin yum don bde blag rtogs par 'dod pa'i skye bo blo gros dman pa 'ga' zhig gis/ /bla ma'i legs bshad zab rgyas mi rtogs de phyir bdag gis chu thigs lta bu 'di brtsams so// sbas don mngon rtogs 'chad tshe yang*// dngos bstan stong nyid du lhung ba'i// mkhas rnams mtshar byas tshur shog dang*// bstan bcos 'di la blta bar gyis// des na 'di brtsams pa dang 'di la gzhan gyis rjes su yi rang dang*/ / 'di nyid bklags dang 'di la thos bsam nyams len bgyis pa gang yin rnams/ /mtha' yas sems can 'khrul pa'i dri ma sdug bsngal rgya mtsho skems pa'i phyir/ /sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal nyid du 'khor gsum dag pas bsngo bar bgyi// zhes pa ni rang gzhan kun la phan par sems pa'i blos rab tu bskul nas zhwa dmar pa lnga pas rang lo nyer gsum gyi thog lug lo zla ba brgyad pa la grub par byas pa'i dge bas mtshungs med bla ma'i dgongs pa rdzogs nas bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa yun ring du gnas par gyur cig/
bkra shis dpal bar 'dzim gling rgyan du shog/ //
